title: The LORD Hears You
verse: God heard their groaning; God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob. God saw the Israelites, and God understood.
observation: Israel had been in slavery for hundreds of years. We can sometimes think the Lord doesn’t hear us after a weekend of prayer. Can you imagine how alone and forsaken the nation of Israel must have felt? However, they were never alone. God heard them. God remembered them. God saw them. When the time was right, the Lord moved. We do not always know why God’s timetable is what it is. We do not always understand why God waits as long as He does. However, we know the Lord is good and His mercy shines forever. Therefore, we can trust that He never allows us to suffer for no reason. Our job is to be faithful and to trust the Lord in all things.
application: Are you willing to wait for the Lord?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for seeing us in every struggle.
